component.name: HomeScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.tabNames = ["AO VIVO", "FILMES", "SÉRIES", "JOGOS DE HOJE", "CONTINUAR", "SAIR"] m.tabW = [190, 190, 190, 330, 250, 150] m.kinds = ["live", "movie", "series"] m.catActs = ["get_live_categories", "get_vod_categories", "get_series_categories"] m.strActs = ["get_live_streams", "get_vod_streams", "get_series"] m.tabFocus = m.top.findNode("tabFocus") m.tabLine = m.top.findNode("tabLine") m.searchBtn = m.top.findNode("searchBtn") m.searchLbl = m.top.findNode("searchLbl") m.cats = m.top.findNode("cats") m.grid = m.top.findNode("grid") m.chList = m.top.findNode("chList") m.games = m.top.findNode("games") m.epgPanel = m.top.findNode("epgPanel") m.epgName = m.top.findNode("epgName") m.epgNow = m.top.findNode("epgNow") m.epgDesc = m.top.findNode("epgDesc") m.epgNext = m.top.findNode("epgNext") m.msg = m.top.findNode("msg") m.catTimer = m.top.findNode("catTimer") m.epgTimer = m.top.findNode("epgTimer")
grp = m.top.findNode("tabsGroup") m.tabLabels = [] m.tabX = [] x = 420 for i = 0 to 5 l = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Label") l.translation = [x, 36] l.width = m.tabW[i] l.height = 64 l.horizAlign = "center" l.vertAlign = "center" l.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" l.text = m.tabNames[i] grp.appendChild(l) m.tabLabels.Push(l) m.tabX.Push(x) x = x + m.tabW[i] + 10 end for
m.catNodes = {} m.raw = {} m.nodes = {} m.epgCache = {} m.tab = -1 m.tabSel = 0 m.zone = "tabs" m.curKey = "" m.pendingCat = 0 m.current = invalid m.gamesTask = invalid m.gamesNode = invalid
m.cats.observeField("itemFocused", "onCatFocused") m.cats.observeField("itemSelected", "onCatSelected") m.grid.observeField("itemSelected", "onGridSelected") m.chList.observeField("itemSelected", "onChSelected") m.chList.observeField("itemFocused", "onChFocused") m.games.observeField("itemSelected", "onGameSelected") m.catTimer.observeField("fire", "onCatTimer") m.epgTimer.observeField("fire", "onEpgTimer")
showTab(0) updateHighlights() end sub
sub refocus() goZone(m.zone) end sub
' ---------- abas ---------- sub showTab(i as Integer) if i = m.tab then return m.tab = i m.tabLine.translation = [m.tabX[i], 104] m.tabLine.width = m.tabW[i] m.cats.visible = (i <= 2) m.searchBtn.visible = (i <= 2) m.searchLbl.visible = (i <= 2) m.grid.visible = false m.chList.visible = false m.epgPanel.visible = false m.games.visible = false m.msg.text = "" m.current = invalid if i <= 2 loadCategories() else if i = 3 showGames() else if i = 4 showContinue() end if end sub
sub selTab(i as Integer) m.tabSel = i if i <= 4 then showTab(i) updateHighlights() end sub
sub updateHighlights() inTabs = (m.zone = "tabs") m.tabFocus.visible = inTabs m.tabFocus.translation = [m.tabX[m.tabSel], 36] m.tabFocus.width = m.tabW[m.tabSel] for i = 0 to 5 if i = m.tab or (inTabs and i = m.tabSel) m.tabLabels[i].color = "0xFFFFFFFF" else m.tabLabels[i].color = "0xFFFFFFAA" end if end for if m.zone = "search" m.searchBtn.color = "0xE5231FFF" else m.searchBtn.color = "0xFFFFFF33" end if end sub
sub goZone(z as String) m.zone = z if z = "cats" m.cats.setFocus(true) else if z = "content" if m.tab = 0 m.chList.setFocus(true) else if m.tab = 3 m.games.setFocus(true) else m.grid.setFocus(true) end if else m.top.setFocus(true) end if updateHighlights() end sub
' ---------- categorias ---------- sub loadCategories() key = m.tab.ToStr() if m.catNodes.DoesExist(key) m.cats.content = m.catNodes[key] m.cats.jumpToItem = 0 loadCategory(0) return end if m.msg.text = "Carregando categorias..." Fetch(Api(m.catActs[m.tab]), "cats" + key, "onCats") end sub
sub onCats(event as Object) res = event.getData() tab = Int(Val(Mid(event.getRoSGNode().tag, 5))) if not res.ok or type(res.data) <> "roArray" if tab = m.tab then m.msg.text = "Erro ao carregar. Confira sua conta e a internet." return end if list = [] for each c in res.data if type(c) = "roAssociativeArray" list.Push({ title: Sx(c.category_name), cid: Sx(c.category_id) }) end if end for key = tab.ToStr() m.catNodes[key] = BuildNode(list) if tab = m.tab m.msg.text = "" m.cats.content = m.catNodes[key] loadCategory(0) end if end sub
sub onCatFocused() m.pendingCat = m.cats.itemFocused m.catTimer.control = "stop" m.catTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onCatSelected() goZone("content") end sub
sub onCatTimer() loadCategory(m.pendingCat) end sub
sub loadCategory(idx as Integer) c = m.cats.content if c = invalid then return node = c.getChild(idx) if node = invalid then return key = m.tab.ToStr() + ":" + node.cid m.curKey = key if m.nodes.DoesExist(key) showItems(key) return end if m.grid.visible = false m.chList.visible = false m.epgPanel.visible = false m.msg.text = "Carregando..." Fetch(Api(m.strActs[m.tab], "&category_id=" + node.cid), "str" + key, "onStreams") end sub
sub onStreams(event as Object) res = event.getData() key = Mid(event.getRoSGNode().tag, 4) tab = Int(Val(key)) if res.ok and type(res.data) = "roArray" list = BuildList(res.data, m.kinds[tab]) m.raw[key] = list m.nodes[key] = BuildNode(list) if key = m.curKey then showItems(key) else if key = m.curKey then m.msg.text = "Não foi possível carregar esta categoria." end if end sub
sub showItems(key as String) m.current = m.raw[key] m.msg.text = "" if m.current.Count() = 0 then m.msg.text = "Nada nesta categoria." if m.tab = 0 m.chList.content = m.nodes[key] m.chList.visible = true m.epgPanel.visible = true m.chList.jumpToItem = 0 onChFocused() else m.grid.content = m.nodes[key] m.grid.visible = true m.grid.jumpToItem = 0 end if end sub
' ---------- selecionar ---------- sub onGridSelected() c = m.grid.content if c = invalid then return n = c.getChild(m.grid.itemSelected) if n <> invalid then m.top.selected = ItemInfo(n) end sub
sub onChSelected() c = m.chList.content if c = invalid then return n = c.getChild(m.chList.itemSelected) if n <> invalid then m.top.selected = ItemInfo(n) end sub
sub onGameSelected() c = m.games.content if c = invalid then return n = c.getChild(m.games.itemSelected) if n <> invalid then m.top.selected = ItemInfo(n) end sub
sub openSearch() if m.current <> invalid m.top.search = { kind: m.kinds[m.tab], items: m.current } end if end sub
' ---------- EPG sem abrir o canal ---------- sub onChFocused() m.epgTimer.control = "stop" m.epgTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onEpgTimer() c = m.chList.content if c = invalid then return n = c.getChild(m.chList.itemFocused) if n = invalid then return m.epgName.text = n.title sid = n.sid m.epgSid = sid if m.epgCache.DoesExist(sid) showEpg(m.epgCache[sid]) else m.epgNow.text = "Carregando programação..." m.epgDesc.text = "" m.epgNext.text = "" Fetch(Api("get_short_epg", "&stream_id=" + sid + "&limit=6"), "epg" + sid, "onEpg") end if end sub
function ParseEpg(list as Object) as Object now = CreateObject("roDateTime").AsSeconds() out = { now: "Sem programação no momento", desc: "", nextt: "" } lines = "" for each e in list if type(e) = "roAssociativeArray" ts = Int(Val(Sx(e.start_timestamp))) te = Int(Val(Sx(e.stop_timestamp))) t = B64(Sx(e.title)) if ts <= now and te > now out.now = "AGORA " + ClockStr(ts) + " - " + ClockStr(te) + Chr(10) + t out.desc = B64(Sx(e.description)) else if ts > now lines = lines + ClockStr(ts) + " " + t + Chr(10) end if end if end for if lines <> "" then out.nextt = "A SEGUIR" + Chr(10) + lines return out end function
sub onEpg(event as Object) res = event.getData() sid = Mid(event.getRoSGNode().tag, 4) data = { now: "Sem programação disponível", desc: "", nextt: "" } if res.ok if type(res.data) = "roAssociativeArray" if type(res.data.epg_listings) = "roArray" then data = ParseEpg(res.data.epg_listings) end if end if m.epgCache[sid] = data if sid = m.epgSid then showEpg(data) end sub
sub showEpg(d as Object) m.epgNow.text = d.now m.epgDesc.text = d.desc m.epgNext.text = d.nextt end sub
' ---------- jogos do dia ---------- sub showGames() m.games.visible = true if m.gamesNode <> invalid then m.games.content = m.gamesNode if m.gamesTask <> invalid then return m.msg.text = "Procurando jogos de hoje..." t = CreateObject("roSGNode", "GamesTask") t.observeField("games", "onGames") t.observeField("status", "onGamesStatus") t.observeField("done", "onGamesDone") m.gamesTask = t t.control = "RUN" end sub
sub onGames(event as Object) arr = event.getData() list = [] for each g in arr o = MakeItem("live") o.sid = g.id o.title = g.line list.Push(o) end for fi = m.games.itemFocused m.gamesNode = BuildNode(list) m.games.content = m.gamesNode if fi > 0 then m.games.jumpToItem = fi if m.tab = 3 and list.Count() > 0 then m.msg.text = "" end sub
sub onGamesStatus(event as Object) if m.tab <> 3 then return empty = true if m.gamesNode <> invalid if m.gamesNode.getChildCount() > 0 then empty = false end if if empty then m.msg.text = event.getData() end sub
sub onGamesDone() if m.tab <> 3 then return if m.gamesNode = invalid if m.msg.text = "" then m.msg.text = "Nenhum jogo encontrado hoje." else if m.gamesNode.getChildCount() = 0 m.msg.text = "Nenhum jogo encontrado hoje nos canais de esportes." end if end sub
' ---------- continuar assistindo ---------- sub showContinue() p = LoadProgress() arr = [] for each k in p.Keys() v = p[k] if type(v) = "roAssociativeArray" if v.done <> true then arr.Push(v) end if end for arr.SortBy("t", "r") list = [] for each v in arr o = MakeItem(v.k) o.sid = v.id o.title = v.title o.hdposterurl = v.cover o.ext = v.ext o.pos = v.pos o.dur = v.dur o.key = v.key o.series = v.series o.season = v.season o.epnum = v.epnum o.direct = true list.Push(o) end for m.grid.content = BuildNode(list) m.grid.visible = true if list.Count() = 0 then m.msg.text = "Você ainda não começou a assistir nada." end sub
' ---------- teclas ---------- function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false z = m.zone if z = "tabs" if key = "left" if m.tabSel > 0 then selTab(m.tabSel - 1) return true else if key = "right" if m.tabSel < 5 then selTab(m.tabSel + 1) return true else if key = "down" or key = "OK" if m.tabSel = 5 if key = "OK" then m.top.logout = true return true end if if m.tab <= 2 goZone("cats") else goZone("content") end if return true end if else if z = "search" if key = "up" goZone("tabs") else if key = "down" goZone("content") else if key = "left" goZone("cats") else if key = "OK" openSearch() else return false end if return true else if z = "cats" if key = "right" goZone("content") else if key = "up" or key = "back" goZone("tabs") else return false end if return true else if z = "content" if key = "left" if m.tab <= 2 goZone("cats") return true end if else if key = "up" if m.tab <= 2 goZone("search") else goZone("tabs") end if return true else if key = "back" if m.tab <= 2 goZone("cats") else goZone("tabs") end if return true else if key = "options" if m.tab = 3 m.gamesTask = invalid m.gamesNode = invalid m.games.content = invalid showGames() return true end if end if end if return false end function
